episodes.186442: Northwest winds in the wake of a cold frontal passage briefly gusted to storm force at Rock of Ages Light and Passage Island Light on the evening of the 16th.
episodes.187107: A low pressure system near the Florida peninsula brought strong gradient winds and flooding rainfall to east central Florida.

events.narrative: Emergency management confirmed a total of ten buildings with water intrusion in Fellsmere and Vero Lake Estates. Also reports that all lanes of 101st Ave were closed at 85th St in Vero Lake Estates. There was a petroleum spill due to eight stalled vehicles. In addition, all lanes of 79th St were closed in Fellsmere and two vehicles were stalled in Fellsmere due to the flooding rain.
Weather Underground site KFLPALMB480 measured 9.69 inches of rainfall.

events.narrative: Northwest winds gusted briefly to storm force at the Passage Island Light C-MAN station in the wake of a cold frontal passage on the evening of the 16th.
Weather Underground site KFLVEROB526 measured 9.08 inches of rainfall.

Weather underground site KFLFELLS9 measured 8.09 inches of rainfall. Emergency management reports most streets in Fellsmere have water covering them, up to a foot of standing water reported in some locations.
